flow_summary: The interviewer successfully completed the intake and gathered all necessary clinical information. However, the system struggled with the 'past_psychiatric_history' section, where it continued to ask follow-up questions about biological treatments despite the patient clearly stating they had never received them.

issues.evidence: The interviewer continued to ask 'When was it received?', 'Where was it received?', and 'Approximately how many sessions did you receive?' after the patient had already clarified they had not received any of those treatments.
